background: CaixaBank is Spain's largest domestic bank by loans and deposits, formed from the la Caixa savings bank and its takeover of Bankia, with a retail, insurance and asset-management franchise concentrated in Spain and Portugal.
synthesis: Rated A+ on average across all three, the weakest of them at A, all three on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 8 Jul 2026. Capital is the weak side against EU and Nordic banks, with CET1 of 12.3% in the bottom quarter and leverage of 5.5% just below the peer median. Liquidity is the strength, LCR of 193% and NSFR of 143% both in the top quarter, though LCR has fallen 14 points and NSFR 6 points since 30 Jun 2025. No rating action has been taken in the last 90 days.
